5-LOX salt-bridge locations

Interactive structural reference · rotate, zoom and inspect saved scenes

Interpretation
All scenes use one structural reference, not different MD conformations. Dashed links are schematic charged-side-chain connections, not measured salt-bridge distances. Link widths and spacing do not encode counts, rates or occupancies.

WT, CRYO and ATP are the original saved condition labels. They have not been relabelled as ATP+ or ATP+out. Comparison colours indicate the increase/decrease classifications saved in the PyMOL scenes.

This is a browser adaptation, not a pixel-identical PyMOL rendering. Spin rotates a static structure; it is not an MD trajectory.

Export details

Centroid atoms: Asp OD1/OD2; Glu OE1/OE2; Lys NZ; Arg NE/NH1/NH2. Only atoms present in the reference are used. Exact PyMOL camera clipping, custom meshes, maps and surfaces are not exported.

Browser rendering: 3Dmol.js. Public viewer data and JavaScript can be inspected; the original Python analysis is not included.
